scope.purpose: Cross-page visual-system observations for implementation consistency. Page-specific visual specifications remain authoritative for page-specific geometry.
scope.authority_rule: These shared observations support reuse and consistency but must not override a clear page-specific observation in an approved mockup or page visual specification.

design_language.composition: Strong rectangular geometry, disciplined alignment, generous white space in commerce areas, cinematic dark photographic bands in brand/storytelling areas, and limited use of gold as emphasis.

color_system.rule: Screenshot-derived colors are estimates, not verified brand tokens. Approved brand assets/theme tokens should replace these estimates when verified.

observations: frequently navy on white or white on dark

exact_font_family.resolution: Verify against approved Calder brand font assets and current Shopify theme typography tokens.

geometry_and_spacing.container_behavior: Consumer pages use centered desktop containers for primary content while selected hero, newsletter, contact and footer regions extend full width.
geometry_and_spacing.alignment_rule: Repeated components within a page deliberately share left/right content edges. Preserve these relationships before matching isolated pixel values.
geometry_and_spacing.corner_language: Predominantly square or very low-radius controls/cards; rounded/pill geometry is reserved mainly for compact status indicators.
geometry_and_spacing.borders: Thin, restrained light-gray or navy/gold outlines; borders define commerce controls without creating heavy card chrome.
geometry_and_spacing.shadows: Soft and restrained; most evident on floating fitment cards and selected elevated surfaces.

gold_primary.appearance: Warm gold rectangular fill, low radius, tracked uppercase label, often arrow or lock/cart affordance.

navy_primary.appearance: Deep navy rectangular fill with white uppercase text and occasional right arrow.

outline_secondary.appearance: Transparent/white background with thin navy or gold border and uppercase label.

button_system.invariant: Primary and secondary actions remain rectangular and visually disciplined; avoid generic rounded SaaS buttons.

form_system.inputs: White/light fields with thin gray border, low radius, compact labels and clear dropdown indicators.
form_system.fitment_controls: Year/Make/Model/Trim is a recurring structured interaction. Selected vehicle context persists deeper into the commerce flow.
form_system.checkout_fields: Larger form fields retain the same restrained border language with strong numbered section anchors.

imagery_system.marketing: Cinematic installed-wheel/vehicle photography, mountain/road environments, wheel macro photography and manufacturing imagery.
imagery_system.commerce: Clean isolated wheel renders on white/light backgrounds with high product prominence.
imagery_system.engineering: Machining/manufacturing imagery reinforces precision and material claims.
imagery_system.rule: Do not replace supplied/approved wheel renders with AI-recreated wheel designs. Product geometry and Calder branding must remain faithful to supplied assets.
imagery_system.crop_behavior: Marketing imagery frequently uses tight cover crops and deliberate wheel focal points; commerce renders favor contain-like presentation with breathing room.

iconography.style: Simple line/outline icons with technical automotive character; generally monochrome navy/white with gold accents.

fitment_confirmed.appearance: Green check/status mark plus green uppercase confirmation and vehicle identification.

selected_or_active.appearance: Gold border/accent, navy active fill, or stronger contrast depending component family.

status_pills.appearance: Compact rounded badges reserved for operational/order/account states.
status_pills.scope: Dealer portal and selected commerce status contexts

component_families.variant_note: Navigation labels differ slightly among approved references; reconcile final copy against authoritative project navigation content rather than averaging screenshots.
Column labels/content vary slightly by mockup.

page_shells.description: Full dark consumer header plus full marketing footer.
Distraction-minimized white secure header and compact dark support footer; no consumer marketing navigation.
Authenticated application shell with fixed-width dark sidebar and white account utility bar; shares Calder brand language but not consumer IA.

responsive_assumptions.assumption: Likely become a drawer or compact filter control.
Likely stack vertically on narrow screens.

implementation_invariants: Preserve relationship-based alignment before tuning isolated pixel measurements.
Do not average page-specific container widths or gutters into a single forced token.
Treat navy/white/gold hierarchy as a system invariant while verifying exact tokens from brand assets.
Preserve fitment context through browse, product, cart and checkout.
Keep product renders faithful to supplied/approved wheel assets.
Use controlled variants for consumer, checkout and dealer shells rather than forcing one shell across all pages.
Use shared-component changes cautiously and regression-check previously accepted pages.
Do not convert screenshot bounding boxes into blanket absolute positioning.

uncertainties.unknown: Exact family/weights are not proven by screenshots.
uncertainties.resolution: Verify brand kit and theme tokens.

uncertainties.unknown: Minor content differences exist among approved page mockups.
uncertainties.resolution: Use project content/navigation authority while preserving the approved visual treatment.

uncertainties.unknown: No approved responsive screenshots are included.
uncertainties.resolution: Treat responsive behavior as implementation inference until responsive references are approved.

uncertainties.unknown: Static references do not prove sticky/fixed behavior for most controls.
uncertainties.resolution: Inspect existing theme functionality and project requirements.
